title: English Vocabulary · การวิเคราะห์และหลักฐาน

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “Two independent records corroborated the witness’s account.”, what does “corroborate” mean?
questions.answer: support a statement through other evidence
options: support a statement through other evidence
questions.explanation: Here, “corroborate” means to support a statement through other evidence.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The authors attributed part of the increase to rising costs.”, what does “attribute” mean?
questions.answer: identify as arising from a source or cause
options: identify as arising from a source or cause
compare the size of two effects
questions.explanation: Here, “attribute” means to identify as arising from a source or cause.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “Missing costs may understate the total burden.”, what does “understate” mean?
questions.answer: represent as smaller or less important than it is
options: represent as smaller or less important than it is
questions.explanation: Here, “understate” means to represent as smaller or less important than it is.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The analysts warned against extrapolating beyond the observed time period.”, what does “extrapolate” mean?
questions.answer: extend a pattern beyond the observations
options: extend a pattern beyond the observations
exclude a data point because it is extreme
questions.explanation: Here, “extrapolate” means to extend a pattern beyond the observations.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The author qualified the conclusion by noting the narrow sample.”, what does “qualify” mean?
questions.answer: limit or add a condition to a statement in this context
options: limit or add a condition to a statement in this context
remove every condition from a claim
confirm that an applicant meets a threshold
questions.explanation: Here, “qualify” means to limit or add a condition to a statement in this context.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The note differentiated approval from payment.”, what does “differentiate” mean?
questions.explanation: Here, “differentiate” means to distinguish.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The interim findings foreshadowed later revisions.”, what does “foreshadow” mean?
questions.answer: suggest in advance that something will happen
options: suggest in advance that something will happen
verify that a prediction was right
questions.explanation: Here, “foreshadow” means to suggest in advance that something will happen.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “A second check attenuated the apparent difference.”, what does “attenuate” mean?
questions.answer: weaken or reduce the strength of an effect
options: weaken or reduce the strength of an effect
questions.explanation: Here, “attenuate” means to weaken or reduce the strength of an effect.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The interim agreement does not preclude revision.”, what does “preclude” mean?
questions.explanation: Here, “preclude” means to prevent or rule out.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The agency released data to rebut the allegation.”, what does “rebut” mean?
questions.answer: respond with an argument or evidence against a claim
options: respond with an argument or evidence against a claim
questions.explanation: Here, “rebut” means to respond with an argument or evidence against a claim.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The analysts inferred a change in demand from the new figures.”, what does “infer” mean?
questions.answer: draw a conclusion from available evidence
options: draw a conclusion from available evidence
quote a passage word for word
questions.explanation: Here, “infer” means to draw a conclusion from available evidence.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The panel scrutinized the revised cost estimate.”, what does “scrutinize” mean?
questions.explanation: Here, “scrutinize” means to examine closely and critically.

questions.subject: en

questions.explanation: Here, “differentiate” means to distinguish.

questions.subject: en

questions.question: Choose the word that expresses this meaning: “prevent or rule out”. A narrow review should not ___ reexamining the issue when new evidence arrives.
questions.explanation: Here, “preclude” means to prevent or rule out.

questions.explanation: Here, “rebut” means to respond with an argument or evidence against a claim.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: Choose the word that expresses this meaning: “draw a conclusion from available evidence”. We can ___ that the deadline shifted by comparing the two notices.
